gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-mochiy-pop-one: Chunky and cheerful, Mochiy Pop One hangs its giant lowercase like laundry on a line beneath the stencil-sharp Wallpoet heading. A long page of it stays friendly.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-mochiy-pop-p-one: Mochiy Pop P One spaces its generous, sizable lowercase wide apart, every stroke the same weight, under Wallpoet's heading. Wallpoet shouts; the sans simply talks.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-montserrat-underline: Montserrat Underline has oversized lowercase and smooth round bowls. Wallpoet's gapped, high-rising letters sit above it, giving the page a loud top and a quiet, plotted-looking body.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-mozilla-headline: Loud meets friendly here: Wallpoet's gapped, towering letters sit over big-bodied lowercase with a splayed c terminal. Paragraphs in Mozilla Headline feel approachable.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-mozilla-text: Mozilla Text has tall lowercase bodies that look bold and terminals that flare outward, set against Wallpoet's gapped, rising display letters. Their strongest quality is that two loud-looking voices never fight.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-nata-sans: Wide, unclosed curves and a technical-pen steadiness make Nata Sans read cleanly, with a large central band in every line. Nata Sans is the quiet counterweight to Wallpoet's bold, gapped heading, and that gap in temperament is the pair's best trait.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-nobile: Nobile reads tight and open at once, its capitals barely above the lowercase and its letter mouths left unjoined like chalk arcs. Wallpoet's commanding gapped heading against that restraint is the pair's best quality.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-nokora: Wallpoet's gapped lines let the page show through its letters. Nokora lays a thick, dark stripe of lowercase across every line, with a wide s that never tightens, so a long stretch feels solid and approachable.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-kufi-arabic: Gapped, towering, unapologetically loud: that is Wallpoet. Noto Kufi Arabic answers with an open, welcoming c and capitals barely above lowercase, so the pair's strongest quality is a modern sans that lets the heading boom.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans: Noto Sans fills its letter height with lowercase and opens every c wide. Wallpoet does the shouting, with smooth bends and gaps of paper between letters, while this body simply carries the words.
